typography.body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.headings: Inter/system sans; very heavy weights with tight tracking

component_patterns.header: White translucent sticky header with ink wordmark and teal accent; dark ink CTA.
component_patterns.hero: Cream-to-white gradient/radial mint treatment, large tight-tracked headline, teal eyebrow, two-column hero with white glassy card.
component_patterns.buttons: Primary teal with rounded-12px corners; secondary white with line border; text CTAs use teal-dark underlined treatment.
component_patterns.cards: White cards with fine line borders, 18-24px radius, restrained shadow and slight hover lift.
component_patterns.badges: Mint/teal pill labels; coral reserved for gift-score/highlight use.
component_patterns.business_mark: Compact rounded square using navy-to-teal gradient.

visual_grammar.tone: Local, useful, independent-business focused, warm but credible.
visual_grammar.density: Editorial/local-directory feel with generous spacing and compact cards.
visual_grammar.icons: Minimal; colour and typography carry most of the identity.
visual_grammar.imagery: Local-business and place imagery where useful; not mandatory on every asset.
visual_grammar.graphics: For social graphics use cream/white fields, teal/ink hierarchy, mint support shapes and occasional coral accent. Keep typography dominant and locally grounded.
